mapper.select: SELECT ad.real_name AS operatorName, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(a.params, '$[1].approved') AS UNSIGNED) = 1 AS approved, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.params, '$[1].remark')) AS remark, a.create_time AS createTime FROM audit_log a LEFT JOIN admin ad ON a.operator_id = ad.id WHERE a.target_type = 'SHOW' AND a.target_id = #{showId} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
